Name: Phinehas, Son of Eli
Summary: Phinehas, son of Eli, served as a priest at Shiloh with his brother Hophni. Both men abused the offerings, and both died when the Philistines captured the ark. His wife died naming her son Ichabod, 'the glory is departed.'
KeyStory: Phinehas died on the day the ark was taken, and his son was named for the glory that had left Israel.
RelatedPeople: Eli; Hophni; Ichabod, Son of Phinehas; Ahitub, Son of Phinehas
LifeLesson: Sin in a priest's house does not stay private; it costs a whole nation its sense of God's presence.
